one_liner_zh: 雷神技術EPS超預期5.3%，季度營收逾242億美元顯示國防與航太需求穩固。
one_liner_en: RTX beat EPS by 5.3% with $24.2B revenue, reflecting solid defense and aerospace demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期5.34%屬穩健達標，營收242.4億為本批最高（年增率未揭露）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正面：5.3%的EPS超預期搭配本批最高的單季營收，顯示雷神國防與航太需求穩固、獲利執行扎實。短期對股價偏多，惟營收年增率未揭露使成長趨勢判讀有限。中期關鍵在訂單積壓轉換與售後服務利潤率。追蹤指標：各部門營收與利潤率、訂單積壓、自由現金流、國防訂單能見度與全年指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: a 5.3% EPS beat with the batch's highest quarterly revenue shows RTX's defense and aerospace demand solid and execution sound. Near-term bullish, though undisclosed YoY limits growth-trend reads. Mid-term the key is backlog conversion and aftermarket margins. Track: segment revenue and margins, backlog, free cash flow, defense order visibility and full-year guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.55美元，超出預期1.47美元，超預期幅度5.34%
營收242.4億美元，為本批最高單季營收，需求基礎扎實
國防與商用航太多元業務分散風險
龐大訂單積壓支撑中長期營收能見度
highlights_en: EPS of $1.55 beat the $1.47 estimate by 5.34%
Revenue of $24.24B, the highest single-quarter figure in this batch, signals a solid demand base
Diversified defense and commercial-aerospace businesses spread risk
A large backlog underpins medium-to-long-term revenue visibility
risks_zh: 營收年增率未揭露，成長趨勢方向待確認
供應鏈瓶頸與零件交付限制產量
高估值下國防預算與航太循環的雙重風險
risks_en: Revenue YoY not disclosed, so the growth trend needs confirmation
Supply-chain bottlenecks and parts delivery constrain output
Dual risk from defense budgets and the aerospace cycle at an elevated valuation
